name: Rails Engine + Postgres (Codespaces)
postCreateCommand: git lfs install && if [ -z "${BOWERBIRD_ORG_CI_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo 'Missing BOWERBIRD_ORG_CI_TOKEN. Configure the Codespaces or local environment secret before running bundle install.' >&2; exit 1; fi && bundle config set --local github.com "x-access-token:${BOWERBIRD_ORG_CI_TOKEN}" && bundle install && cd test/dummy && bundle install && bundle exec rails db:prepare && bundle exec rails tailwindcss:build
